lines.text: Private markets still run on spreadsheets. Wall Street's smartest shops just proved AI can keep up.
Thinking Machines Lab. Seventy-five percent on real Excel tasks. Not chat — execution.
This weekend — Encode Hub, London. Ylookup and Encode. One mandate: rebuild private markets.
We took the research track. Same benchmark. Open Qwen. Sixty-eight percent — nine above the floor.
The playbook is public. Your data. Your model. Niche beats general.
One Docker run. Four hundred tasks. Holdout ready.
